description: This PHP source file defines the API endpoints for managing and retrieving a user's leave requests within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It includes methods for listing, retrieving, creating, and updating leave requests, with detailed annotations for API documentation and validation rules.

classes.name: MyLeaveRequestAPI
classes.description: API class enhancing leave request functionalities for the current user, including listing, retrieving, creating, and updating leave requests, with integrated validation and authorization mechanisms.

methods.name: getLeaveApplicationService
methods.description: Lazy loader for the LeaveApplicationService dependency, ensures a singleton instance within the class.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific leave request for the authenticated user, inherits logic from parent class.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all leave requests for the authenticated user, supporting filtering, sorting, and metadata.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new leave request for the authenticated user, with validation and detailed response.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for listing leave requests with filters.

methods.name: checkLeaveRequestAccessible
methods.description: Authorization check to ensure current user can access the specific leave request.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing leave request, primarily for actions like approval, rejection, or cancellation.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Not implemented; attempting to delete a leave request will raise a 'Not implemented' exception.

methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a new leave request.
